get.description: Each event's `id` is its sequence number; reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` (or `?after=`) to resume. The stream ends with an `end` event once the job has finished.

get.summary: Exports of a version, newest first

post.description: Converts the version, re-opens the file with an independent reader and compares triangle count, size and texture with the source. A file that does not match is reported as failed and not stored.
post.summary: Export a version to another format

post.description: Simplified copies (about a quarter of the triangles each) for drawing the model when full detail would not be visible. The version's own file is unchanged.

get.summary: Preview image rendered by the provider (WebP)

delete.summary: Delete a model, all its versions and files

post.description: Runs the quality profile's geometry and texture processing. The source version is never changed; the result is a new `enhanced` version.
post.summary: Enhance a version into a new version (background job, on this machine)
Preview the processing steps an enhancement would run

post.description: Without `cloud_upload_consent` (or in a local-only project) the job waits for permission and nothing is sent. Tripo can only re-texture models it generated. The result is a new `enhanced` version; the source version is never changed.
post.summary: Re-texture a version with a cloud service (uploads the model)

post.description: The parent version is kept unchanged. The file is re-opened and checked like provider output; a file that fails the checks is rejected (422) and nothing is stored. The new version becomes the model's current version.
post.summary: Save an edited GLB as a new version

post.description: Creates a new project (new IDs). Photos go through the normal upload checks and every model file is re-opened and checked; if anything fails, nothing is kept.
post.summary: Restore a project from a backup ZIP

delete.summary: Delete a project and all of its files

get.description: manifest.json (settings, models, versions, notes, quality reports), the original photos and every version's GLB. Exports and job history are not included.
get.summary: Download the project as a backup ZIP
Assess whether the project's photos are ready for reconstruction

post.description: Matches features between photos on this machine (OpenCV SIFT + RANSAC) and caches the result for the current photo set. Takes a few seconds per 10 photos.
post.summary: Measure overlap between the photos (feature matching)

post.description: Jobs that would send photos to a third-party provider start only with `cloud_upload_consent: true` in a project that allows cloud upload; otherwise the job is created in `waiting_for_consent` and nothing is uploaded.

post.description: Nothing is created or sent. `blocking_issues` explains why a generation cannot run as requested.

post.description: Each file is validated and analysed independently; one bad file does not fail the request. Re-uploading identical bytes returns the existing image (status `duplicate`).
post.summary: Upload one or more photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP)

post.description: GLB, OBJ, STL, PLY, 3MF or FBX (converted by Blender), or a ZIP with an OBJ (plus MTL and textures) or a glTF (plus .bin and images). Converted to GLB, re-opened and checked; a file that fails the checks is rejected (422). The version's origin is recorded as imported and its accuracy as unknown.
